pr_summary.headline: Bumps the cryptography constraint floor from >=48.0.1 to >=50.0.0 in pyproject.toml and regenerates uv.lock to resolve GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5 (PKCS#7 Bleichenbacher oracle).

walkthrough.text: pyproject.toml raises the constraint-dependency floor from cryptography>=48.0.1 to >=50.0.0 and extends the inline advisory comment to document both GHSA-537c-gmf6-5ccf and GHSA-g6cj-pr64-35w5, consistent with the existing comment convention.
uv.lock manifest section mirrors the new specifier (>=50.0.0) so the resolved constraint is consistent with pyproject.toml.

uv.lock package block replaces all 49.0.0 wheel and sdist entries with their 50.0.0 counterparts, covering every supported platform (cp311-abi3, cp39-abi3, cp314-cp314t, pp311-pypy311) including macOS arm64, manylinux, musllinux, armv7l, ppc64le, and win_amd64.

verdict_reasoning.deciding_factor: Nothing blocks the merge. Both files are updated in lockstep, the manifest constraint and resolved package version agree on 50.0.0, all wheel hashes are replaced with published PyPI entries, and the PR's full 8914-test suite run confirms no API breakage from the 49→50 major bump.
